scope: Sanitized real initial dependency-source fingerprint measurements, not synthetic prepared-call latency, frozen E2E evidence, business qualification or complete preflight acceptance.

conclusion.observed: Two bounded ABBA samples per implementation show a 39.220234188352% lower mean wall time for the complete initial source fingerprint call.
conclusion.notClaimed: The historical 2h45m preflight and the over-three-hour workflow have not received complete before/after acceptance. Do not subtract these stage measurements from historical totals or describe the whole workflow as fixed.
conclusion.limitations: Small samples, substantial candidate variation, uncontrolled OS caches, no exclusive host reservation and no physical-IO attribution. This is an observed stage improvement, not a stable percentile or guaranteed production speedup.

revisions.experimentalDifference: Only the full-byte worker cap changed from 8 to 16. No hashing or copy algorithm changed.
revisions.adoptionBoundary: The production follow-up narrows the higher cap to the initial single-source scan. Post-copy source/target verification and pinned prepared verification retain their default cap of 8 per pool. This narrowed production integration is not itself the measured experimental commit.

workload.timed: Complete outputFingerprint call: synchronous planning, bounded worker startup, every dependency byte, aggregate hashing and worker termination.
workload.excluded: Git and inventory guards, dependency copy/link rebase, post-copy byte verification, checkout, native selection/typecheck and business execution.

environment.warmup: None; four bounded complete scans with ABBA ordering, not a cold-cache-controlled experiment.
environment.admission: Three consecutive samples about 20 seconds apart: CPU below 40%, physical disk transfer below 10MiB/s, disk time counter below 30, foreign Node-test CPU below 5%, no detected native acceptance.
environment.cpuScope: Cumulative controller-process CPU including worker threads, excluding untimed Git children.
environment.ioScope: Per-process Windows cumulative IO counters and host-wide physical disk samples were persisted separately. Neither logical hashed bytes nor process IO counters are physical disk throughput attributable to this process.

historicalFirstPreflight.accounting: Child stages are already included in their parents. These historical timings are context, not a comparable current baseline.

evidence.rawReportsAndResourceSamples: Private and retained; source paths, raw inventories, credentials and product contents are not uploaded.
evidence.parentShellExitCode: Unavailable: shell reclaimed. The report and stdout passed, stderr was empty and no benchmark process remained; no parent exit code is invented.
